skills_delete_description: This removes the Skill and its stored archive from this Agent. This cannot be undone.
skills_empty_description: Upload a skill archive to give this Agent reusable know-how.
skills_error_archive_invalid: The archive could not be read. Upload a valid .zip, .skill, .tar.gz, or .tgz archive.
skills_error_archive_too_large: The archive is larger than 16 MiB.
skills_error_client_too_large: This archive is larger than 16 MiB.
skills_error_generic: The Skill request failed. Try again.
skills_error_hash_mismatch: The upload was corrupted in transit. Try again.
skills_error_limit_reached: This Agent already has the maximum number of Skills. Delete one before uploading another.
skills_error_manifest_invalid: The archive's SKILL.md is missing or invalid.
skills_error_name_conflict: A Skill with this name already exists.
skills_error_name_reserved: That Skill name is reserved by the platform. Rename the Skill in its SKILL.md and try again.
skills_error_not_found: That Skill no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
skills_error_preset_not_found: That preset is no longer available.
skills_error_revision_conflict: This Skill changed while you were working. Reload and try again.
skills_error_source_blocked: That source is not reachable from this deployment.
skills_error_source_invalid: That source could not be understood. Paste a repository address or a skills.sh link.
skills_error_source_no_skills: No Skills were found at that source.
skills_error_source_too_large: That source is larger than this deployment will read.
skills_error_source_unreachable: That source could not be reached.
skills_error_storage_unavailable: Skill storage is unavailable on this deployment.
skills_install_already: Already installed — it will be skipped
skills_install_description: Paste a repository address or a skills.sh link. Nothing is installed until you confirm.
skills_install_empty: No Skills were found at that source.
skills_install_result_skipped: Skipped — a Skill with this name already exists
skills_install_unavailable_manifest_inva: Its SKILL.md is missing or invalid
skills_install_unavailable_name_reserved: Its name is reserved by the platform
skills_install_unavailable_path_invalid: It contains a file path a Skill archive cannot hold
skills_install_unavailable_too_large: It is larger than a Skill archive may be
skills_preset_description: Install a Skill the platform ships, or update one you already installed.
skills_preset_load_failed: The presets could not be loaded.
skills_preset_state_name_conflict: Another Skill already uses this name
skills_replace_description: A Skill with the same name already exists. Replacing it overwrites its archive and bumps its revision; the previous archive is deleted.
skills_storage_unavailable: Skill storage is not configured on this deployment, so uploads and downloads are unavailable. Existing Skills are still listed.
